title: growpart: flock disk before modifying partition table
commit_message:
growpart: flock disk before modifying partition table
    
Use an exclusive file lock on the target disk prior to modifying
the partition table to prevent udev scripts from executing while
the state of the partition is being modified.
    
LP: #1834875
diff:
diff --git a/bin/growpart b/bin/growpart
index 33d27f1..e0b4c51 100755
--- a/bin/growpart
+++ b/bin/growpart
@@ -27,6 +27,8 @@ DISK=""
 PART=""
 PT_UPDATE=false
 DRY_RUN=0
+FLOCK_FD="" # this will always be hard coded to 9
+FLOCK_TIMEOUT="2"
 
 SFDISK_VERSION=""
 SFDISK_2_26="22600"
@@ -74,6 +76,9 @@ cleanup() {
 			fi
 		fi
 	fi
+	if [ -n "${FLOCK_FD}" ]; then
+		exec 9>&- # FLOCK_FD variable cannot be used, use 9
+	fi
 	[ -z "${TEMP_D}" -o ! -d "${TEMP_D}" ] || rm -Rf "${TEMP_D}"
 }
 
@@ -808,7 +813,25 @@ get_resizer "$format" "$resizer" ||
 	fail "failed to get a resizer for id '$id'"
 resizer=$_RET
 
+# flock the disk to protect against udev actions while modifying part
+# https://systemd.io/BLOCK_DEVICE_LOCKING/
+FLOCK_FD="9"  # fd must be 3-9 in /bin/sh
+exec 9<>$DISK  # sh syntax cannot use variable FLOCK_FD, use 9
+# we wait $FLOCK_TIMEOUT seconds in case udev is currently processing
+if ! flock --exclusive --timeout $FLOCK_TIMEOUT $FLOCK_FD; then
+	error "WARN: failed to obtain exclusive lock on $DISK"
+fi
+debug 1 "FLOCK: $DISK: obtained exclusive lock"
+
 debug 1 "resizing $PART on $DISK using $resizer"
 "$resizer"
 
+# release the lock
+[ -n "${FLOCK_FD}" ] && {
+	debug 1 "FLOCK: ${DISK}: releasing exclusive lock"
+	exec 9>&- # FLOCK_FD variable cannot be used, use 9
+	FLOCK_FD=""
+	udevadm settle
+}
+
 # vi: ts=4 noexpandtab
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 8cf22dc..5d73854 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+cloud-utils (0.31-6-g16916780-0ubuntu2) focal; urgency=medium

+    [Ryan Harper] (LP: #1834875)
